description: The plot illustrates how the “Harmful with Refusal Ratio” varies with different reminder lengths for two vision-language models evaluated on two datasets. The x-axis is labeled “Reminder Length” and uses a linear scale with discrete tick marks at 128, 256, 512, and 1024 (no units shown). The y-axis is labeled “Harmful with Refusal Ratio,” shown on a linear scale from 0.0 up to about 0.55 with regularly spaced tick labels at 0.1 intervals. Four solid lines with markers are shown: the blue line with circle markers (“LlaVA-1.5-7B on FigStep”) increases from about 0.20 at 128 to ~0.25 at 256, ~0.35 at 512, and ~0.36 at 1024; the orange line with square markers (“Qwen2-VL-7B on FigStep”) rises from ~0.15 at 128 to ~0.23 at 256 and ~0.42 at 512, then remains approximately flat at ~0.42 at 1024; the green line with triangle markers (“LlaVA-1.5-7B on MMSafetyBench”) increases from ~0.07 at 128 to ~0.21 at 256, ~0.37 at 512, and ~0.38 at 1024; the red line with diamond markers (“Qwen2-VL-7B on MMSafetyBench”) increases from ~0.24 at 128 to ~0.26 at 256, ~0.43 at 512, and ~0.52 at 1024.
